name: codex
description: Use Codex from Kimi Code to review code or delegate tasks.
author: Xu Yao (ported from OpenAI's codex-plugin-cc)

interface.shortDescription: Use Codex from Kimi Code to review code or delegate tasks
interface.longDescription: Wraps the local Codex app server so Kimi Code can run read-only reviews, adversarial reviews, and delegate implementation tasks to Codex, with resumable threads and background job tracking. Ported from openai/codex-plugin-cc.
